hooks.command: notify-send --app-name='Claude Code' 'Claude Code' 'Ready for input' >/dev/null 2>&1; pane_tty=$(tmux display-message -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" '#{pane_tty}' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$pane_tty" ] && printf '\033Ptmux;\033\033]9;Claude Code: Ready for input\007\033\\\a' > "$pane_tty"; true

notify-send --app-name='Claude Code' 'Claude Code' 'Question requires input' >/dev/null 2>&1; pane_tty=$(tmux display-message -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" '#{pane_tty}' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$pane_tty" ] && printf '\033Ptmux;\033\033]9;Claude Code: Question requires input\007\033\\\a' > "$pane_tty"; true

notify-send --app-name='Claude Code' 'Claude Code' 'Permission required' >/dev/null 2>&1; pane_tty=$(tmux display-message -p -t "$TMUX_PANE" '#{pane_tty}' 2>/dev/null); [ -n "$pane_tty" ] && printf '\033Ptmux;\033\033]9;Claude Code: Permission required\007\033\\\a' > "$pane_tty"; true
